dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Ah, are you here to see my flower garden today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are our exotic flowers doing?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: After the ugly machine got dug out, no bad Breacher Primuses returned to make a mess of things.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: As such, my precious exotic flowers are growing healthily!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your cultivation of new flowers proceeding?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: ...To be honest, I don't know where to start just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: But if I can make the leaves of these flowers grow into the shape of Tidalga, I might be able to shock the world at the next horticultural fair!

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Okay — I mean, cheering people up is one of the reasons for which flower gardens exist. I hope they'll be able to raise your spirits today, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Th—That was so scary! Thankfully, my garden's alright...

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: I thought that some bad guys were coming to ruin it again... But I've got to protect the flowers we worked so hard to grow together!
